system.description:
The trained marksmen of the Holfast city watch and the Opal harbour guard: crowd control, warning shots, precision at city ranges.

  • Precision Placement: once per round, you may make any hit a Called Shot (Leg) without declaring it before rolling.
    • 9th level: a Called Shot (Arm) too.
  • Badge and Barrel: Advantage on checks to identify criminals from a description, find your way through a city's courts, and act as witness or enforcer of the law where you serve.
